storiesbyvihaa.why: The closest match to the account's best-selling ad type: a child who talks straight to camera. 14 of her 20 recent posts are Viha presenting, and her paid posts keep 91% of normal reach.
storiesbyvihaa.format: Viha piece-to-camera, at the table with her own plate. Her usual phone-shot, home look; no studio.
storiesbyvihaa.hook: Viha, holding up her dosa: "Ee roju naa plate lo emundo chudandi!" (Look what's on my plate today!)
beats: 0-3s: Viha shows her plate and says 'Little Joys' early (brand named in first 3s).
Viha: 'Amma put one scoop of Little Joys Proteinmix in my dosa.' On-screen text: '1 scoop (15g) = 12g plant protein'.
Viha takes a bite: 'Taste same-ey!' (the taste stays the same). Let the reaction be real.
Parent's voice or text: made from pea, brown rice and soy; mixes into dosa batter, roti or chilla.
End card + caption: clear 'Buy now' with link.
claims: Made from pea, brown rice, and soy
Easily mixes into flour, dosa batter, or chilla without altering taste
storiesbyvihaa.language: Make two cuts of the same shoot: (A) English with her Telugu flavour, (B) Telugu. The account has no Telugu ads at all, and the South Indian ones it has (Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam) did poorly, so Telugu is a test, not a sure thing.
storiesbyvihaa.avoid: Viha reading out product specs like an adult (her feed's 'foreign' list). Numbers go on screen, not in her mouth.
watch: Her Instagram audience is 70% men (as of 29 Oct 2026). Run the video as a paid partnership ad aimed at parents rather than relying on her own followers.
She already did a Little Joys collab in the past year. Ask the team for those results before signing; they are not in this data.

hello_ps8.product: Proteinmix pancakes (check the age guidance for a 3-year-old; if it doesn't fit, use Nutrimix 2+ chocolate milk in the same format)
hello_ps8.why: Her paid posts get more plays than her normal ones (1.3x), she speaks English/Hinglish, and her son Vayu (just turned 3) is in most of her videos.
hello_ps8.format: Warm, bright home video with Vayu, the way she already films him. A taste test, not a pitch.
hello_ps8.hook: "One of these pancakes has 12g of extra protein. Let's see if Vayu can tell."
beats: 0-3s: two plates side by side, the line above, 'Little Joys' on screen.
Vayu tries both. His real reaction is the ad; don't script it.
Pratibha: 'The difference? One scoop of Little Joys Proteinmix: 100% plant protein, and it doesn't change the taste.'
Tie it to her own routine: she counts protein for her workouts, and this is how she does it for Vayu.
Close: 'Link in bio, buy now.'
claims: Does not change the taste of the food
hello_ps8.language: English or Hinglish, as in her feed.
hello_ps8.avoid: A stiff studio ad, or a product pitch that has nothing to do with her family (her feed's 'foreign' list).
watch: Vayu is under 6. In the ads, under-6 kids did worse than 6 to 12 year olds (median ROAS 0.98 vs 1.34), so her mom-voice carries more of this ad.
Food and meals are a small part of her feed (about 1 in 10 posts).

the_mum_wife_playbook.why: Her daughter Seerat already talks straight to camera in her videos, and she speaks Hinglish. Small account (median ~20-90k plays), but her paid posts do better than her normal ones.
the_mum_wife_playbook.format: Seerat-led playful moment, the kind of mother-daughter bit she already posts.
the_mum_wife_playbook.hook: Seerat, holding her cup: "Mumma, yeh wala doodh phir se!" (Mumma, this milk again!)
beats: 0-3s: Seerat asks for 'Little Joys wala doodh' by name.
Mumma to camera: 'Isme ragi, bajra, almonds aur walnuts hain, aur meetha sirf jaggery aur dates se.'
Seerat drinks and reacts. Her taste reaction is the proof.
Close: buy-now ask plus link.
claims: Made with Ragi, Bajra, Almonds, Walnuts
Completely sweetened with jaggery and dates
the_mum_wife_playbook.language: Hinglish (her feed is mostly Hindi with English).
the_mum_wife_playbook.avoid: Shooting without Seerat in frame, or TV-ad lighting and polish (both on her feed's 'foreign' list).
watch: Seerat is about 3, and under-6 kids were weaker in the ads.
Low reach: think of this as buying a creative for paid ads, not buying her audience.

ohmother.in.why: Her signature format is the school-morning routine voiceover with two school-age kids. That is the 'routine' story the account uses most, and it is spoken in English.
ohmother.in.format: Her timestamped school-morning montage, with Proteinmix going into the breakfast. Let the older child do the talking.
ohmother.in.hook: Older child to camera, plate in hand: "Guess what's hiding in my paratha?"
beats: 0-3s: the child's line above, 'Little Joys' on screen.
Navya voiceover over the morning rush: one scoop into the dough, no extra recipe.
Child eats: 'It tastes the same!'
On screen: '1 scoop (15g) = 12g plant protein'.
Close: buy-now ask; she already uses discount codes in captions.
claims: Does not alter taste of rotis or batters
ohmother.in.avoid: A mom-only voiceover. A similar rushed-breakfast mom ad (LJ-018) did poorly at ROAS 0.75. What separates the winners is a child doing the talking.
watch: Small reach: her recent paid posts get about 23k plays.
Her bio tags an adult protein brand (one.science.nutrition.in) she promoted on 5 Oct 2026. Check there is no category clash.

foodies_by_neha.why: 1M followers, and she already runs a 'Kid's School Tiffin Box' series in Hinglish, with a 'high protein' tiffin recipe posted on 27 Oct 2026. 'Mix it into everyday food' is the Proteinmix story.
foodies_by_neha.format: Her own 'Tiffin Box Recipe Episode' format: text hook, top-down cooking shots, her voiceover.
foodies_by_neha.hook: On screen: "Tiffin Episode: 12g extra protein, bacche ko pata bhi nahi chalega" (and the kids won't even notice)
beats: 0-3s: episode text hook with 'Little Joys Proteinmix' on screen.
One scoop into the atta; she says the number: '1 scoop mein 12g plant protein.'
Cook and pack, in her usual style.
Taste proof: her son's tiffin comes back empty, or his voice saying the taste is the same.
Close: buy-now ask.
claims: Can be added directly to everyday meals like roti, dosa, cheela, and pancakes without altering familiar tastes
foodies_by_neha.language: Hinglish (her transcripts are Hindi with English; the post label says 'English', which is wrong).
foodies_by_neha.avoid: An ad that never shows the product being used in real cooking (her feed's 'foreign' list).
watch: No children appear in her feed, and a child presenting is the account's strongest pattern. A child taste moment is worth asking for, but it is new for her.
Recipe ads on their own are only about average once LJ-004 is taken out (ROAS 1.21).

on_hold.sia_3vedi: Best fit of all 20: a child presenter with 5.4M median plays. But she posted a paid Gritzo kids'-milk video on 28 Sep 2026. If there is no exclusivity, swap her in for #5 and pitch Proteinmix-in-roti (an LJ-004 style plate video), not milk, so it doesn't look like she switched milk brands.
on_hold.raja_choudhary04: Child-voiced daily vlogs, the winning format. But he did two paid Gritzo posts (Jul and Aug 2026) and a paid Troovy post on 7 Oct 2026. Revisit once those deals end.
on_hold.mumma_and_ridhu: Near-tie for the 5th slot (score within 0.3 of #5). Hinglish, with kids aged 3-12 on camera. Use her if any of the five falls through.
